name: estuda-ai
description: Estuda AI - app de estudos gamificado: PDF da materia vira aula + trilha de exercicios

scripts.start: npm run verificar && npm run build && npm run build:app --workspace @estudaai/mobile && npm run start --workspace @estudaai/api
scripts.dev: npm run verificar && npm run build --workspace @estudaai/shared && npm run dev --workspace @estudaai/api
scripts.web: npm run build --workspace @estudaai/shared && npm run web --workspace @estudaai/mobile
scripts.mobile: npm run build --workspace @estudaai/shared && npm run start --workspace @estudaai/mobile
